name: X
description: Post, reply, quote, poll, search, read mentions, like and repost on X through the v2 API (api.x.com/2). Authentication is either OAuth 1.0a — the four keys the developer portal gives the app owner, which never expire — or an account connected once with `degen-portal connect x`. Requests are signed or bearer-authenticated per call and no credential is ever printed. Writes are billed per call under X's pay-per-use pricing.
